name: BaseLevel.exists_tie
summary: Apply exists_line_stabilizer_log at w_j to a unit ε whose Artin image is τ_j, and build from the Hecke operator U of diag(ϖ, 1, …, 1) (ϖ with Artin image s_j) the operators B(f) = G(U)∘weightedSum(ρ', b)(f), G(X) = p(a(s_j)X), p = (X − q_j^{t−1})e. Then one_prime_first_order gives F; its hypothesis L·B(1) = 0 follows from the chain lemma (base-level eigenforms with T ≠ 0 are orthogonal to the image of G(U)), and its property (ii) is turned into the tie: GL_N acts through det, so τ_j acts as the diamond operator, and on parahoric eigenvectors the trace with τ_j − 1 against G(U) is the trace against G(s_j).
